## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation but narrow top-performer concentration (Leadership: Narrow — 3/5 Energy), and mega-cap divergence (NVDA ABOVE TREND vs AAPL/GOOGL BELOW TREND) supports a neutral read.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +9.76%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strong on winners: INTU (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%) ABOVE TREND and PLTR (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +33.83%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples weak: MO (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.71%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -50.58% | 1M: -52.37%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft with exhaustion signals: RCL (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +6.06%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +33.83%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.18% | 1M: +17.63%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: MNST (1W: -50.58% | 1M: -52.37%) BELOW TREND, AIG (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -6.13% | 1M: +1.52%) CORRECTION, HON (1W: -2.80% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated and idiosyncratic.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +14.84% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +33.83%) ABOVE TREND; Major divergence present (MSFT, META, TSLA show 1W vs 1M mismatch) — tactical volatility risk, not a pure regime signal.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but constructive: NVDA (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +6.02%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth positive and rotation within tech ongoing.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Cautious improvement: JPM (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +4.67%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +3.09%) CORRECTION, AIG (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -0.98%) BELOW TREND — Financials broadly positive but internal dispersion remains (Financials sector participation supportive).

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive tailwinds but mixed names: JNJ (1W: +1.98% | 1M: +6.10%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.22% | 1M: -4.65%) BELOW TREND — overall sector participation healthy yet stock-level dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Energy and standout Tech winners (MPC, PSX, INTU) while reducing exposure to deeply weak Consumer Staples names (MO, MNST); style mixed / no clear leadership. Monitor major-cap divergences and keep position sizing disciplined given neutral regime and concentrated leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MNST (1W: -50.58% | 1M: -52.37%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +10.12%) — leadership gravity; BEARISH: Consumer Staples (1W: -2.73% | 1M: -0.52%) — idiosyncratic stress; watch Tech for intra-sector rotation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
MPC near short-term breakout continuation if weekly momentum holds, NVDA (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +6.02%) ABOVE TREND needs follow-through above recent highs, AAPL (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND is a risk pivot for mega-cap sentiment.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PFE (+75): PFE (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND — higher guidance and trial results; price confirming sentiment. MA (+55): MA (1W: -1.55% | 1M: +5.95%) CORRECTION — bullish news but short-term price pullback is a divergence to watch. MSFT (+50): MSFT (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +25.59%) CORRECTION — upbeat analyst commentary vs 1W softness signals need for follow-through.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
HON (-50): HON (1W: -2.80% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION — event-driven guidance disappointment and price weakness confirm. AMAT (-45): AMAT (news -45) shows earnings disappointment risk; watch semi-cap names for confirmation. INTC (-45): INTC (news -45) headline-driven downside risk — monitor price action for confirmation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. MPC (1W: +19.09% | 1M: +19.12%) ABOVE TREND and INTU (1W: +11.30% | 1M: +28.10%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while AAPL (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND are notable laggards. Key risk is concentrated leadership and major-cap divergences (MSFT/TSLA/META mixed signals) plus event-driven names (PFE/HON) where sentiment vs price is creating tactical tradeoffs.
